name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A key that stays pressed: muted when off, on the gray pill wash with ink text when on; an outline variant adds the strong hairline.
usage: Turn one view option on or off in a toolbar (wrap lines, show raw HTML, pin a filter). Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label. For a setting saved to an account use Switch; for one choice of several use ToggleGroup.
avoid: Icon motion when it is pressed

reference.source: Extrapolated from context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/button.tsx (the ghost and outline buttons)
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
